meal.title: Create UI mock‑ups for the grocery app
meal.objective: Sketch the screens to clarify the user interface before coding

voice.script: What does your grocery app look like before you write a line? How can you plan screens without coding? First, imagine the screen layout on paper. This helps you see the flow and catch missing elements early. Now let's see a quick mock‑up example. You’ll see the sketch on your screen. Remember, a clear mock‑up saves time and reduces rework later. Try drawing the main checkout screen on a sticky note.
